verses.1: And a loud voice was heard in my ears, saying, “Come, bring forth the offerings for the city! Let everyone bring what they have in their hands.”
verses.2: And behold, six men came from the way leading to the upper gate. One of them was carrying a staff in his hand. Another man among them wore a crown on his head. They entered and stood beside the altar of the idolater.
verses.3: And the glory of the God of Israel was revealed above the ark that was on top of it, near the entrance to the temple. He called out to the man who was dressed in white, who was the one whose name was mentioned in the offerings.
verses.4: And the LORD said to him, “Go through the city of Jerusalem. Look at those people who are suffering and in need of help, due to all the hardships they face there.”
verses.5: And to them he said in my ear, “Go into the city of your fellow believers. Do not close your eyes, and do not hide from them.”
verses.6: The old men, women, and girls were killed as victims of destruction. All those who were under the influence of this curse were also destroyed. From my holy places, they began to destroy those old men who stood in front of the temple.
verses.7: And he said to them, “Fill the houses and fill the streets with devils. Come out, and let them be destroyed in the city.”
verses.8: And when they were gone, I stood there, covered in blood. I cried out in pain and said, “Oh Lord Jehovah! You have destroyed everything else in Israel by pouring your wrath upon Jerusalem.”
verses.9: And he said to me, “There will be great destruction in the house of Israel and Judah. The land will be filled with blood, and the city will be full of corpses. For they said, ‘God has abandoned this land; there is no more God to see.’”
verses.10: And I also do not look away from them, nor do I stop their path in their midst.
verses.11: And behold, the man was clothed in fine clothes. The angel who gave him the gifts said, “I have done everything you commanded me to do.”
